summary.key_theme: 華爾街分析師普遍上調 First Solar 目標價，且市場看好其在太陽能關稅政策下的競爭優勢與強勁基本面。

bullish.title: Deutsche Bank Maintains Buy on First Solar, Raises Price Target to $299
bullish.reason: 德意志銀行分析師 Corinne Blanchard 維持買入評級，並將目標價大幅上調至 $299，顯示對公司長期成長潛力的強烈信心。

bullish.title: BMO Capital Upgrades First Solar to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $263
bullish.reason: BMO Capital 將評級從「市場表現」上調至「優於大盤」，反映出市場對該公司獲利能力與市場份額擴張的認可。

bullish.title: First Solar (FSLR) Sold Off After the Tariffs. It’s the Solar Stock Built to Benefit From Them
bullish.reason: 分析指出市場對太陽能關稅的反應過度，First Solar 作為美國本土製造商，實際上是關稅政策的最大受益者，具備長期投資價值。

bullish.title: Argus Research Reiterates Buy on First Solar, Maintains $275 Price Target
bullish.reason: Argus Research 重申買入評級，並維持 $275 的目標價，肯定了公司穩定的營運表現。

bullish.title: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) Stands Out as a Decent Value Stock with Strong Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 該公司以 14 倍本益比交易，具備強勁的利潤率、低負債水平與穩健的成長動能，被視為具備價值的優質標的。

bullish.title: First Solar (FSLR) Looks Repriced As Policy Support Shapes A More Bullish Valuation View
bullish.reason: 政策支持力度增強，使得市場重新評估 First Solar 的估值，長期看漲情緒濃厚。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer: 'Put This Stock Away, Give It to Your Kids'
bullish.reason: 知名財經主持人 Jim Cramer 將 First Solar 列為適合長期持有的標的，增強了散戶投資人的信心。

bullish.title: Why Are ENPH, FSLR, ARRY, SEDG Stocks Rising Overnight?
bullish.reason: 反映了市場對太陽能板塊的整體樂觀情緒，First Solar 作為領頭羊隨板塊同步上漲。

neutral.title: First Solar upgraded, Celsius downgraded: Wall Street's top analyst calls
neutral.reason: 僅為當日華爾街分析師評級變動的彙整報導，屬於中性資訊傳遞，無額外分析觀點。
